description:
🏚️ Welcome to The Hidden House, where the forgotten secrets of old American homes come back to life.

Explore old house history, forgotten home systems, vintage plumbing, antique electrical wiring, historic heating systems, hidden architectural features, and strange household inventions that once shaped everyday life in America. From knob-and-tube wiring and coal furnaces to milk doors, dumbwaiters, Sears kit homes, and Cold War fallout shelters, every episode reveals what may still be hiding behind the walls, beneath the floors, or under the backyard.

🔎 Discover the fascinating stories behind America’s forgotten homes.

🔔 Subscribe to The Hidden House for more hidden history, old home mysteries, and forgotten technology!

videos.title: How a Copper Shortage Put Aluminum Wiring in American Homes and Why Inspectors Still Fear It
How Fuse Boxes Protected America's Homes Until a Penny Behind the Fuse Started the Fires
How Knob-and-Tube Wiring Lit America's Homes and Why So Many Old Houses Still Hide It Today
